topic: Dizilerden: C1 phrasal verb ve collocation'lar

items.example: Just come clean about the missing money.
items.exampleTr: Kayıp para hakkında dürüst ol da söyle.
items.simple: Tell the whole truth after hiding it.
dialogue: A: Where did the cash go?
B: You should come clean before she finds out.
items.note: Breaking Bad ve The Office'te itiraf sahnelerinde.

items.example: She brushed me off when I asked her out.
items.exampleTr: Ona çıkma teklif edince beni savuşturdu.
items.simple: Not take someone seriously. Send them away fast.
dialogue: A: Did she say yes?
B: No, she'll just brush off my question.
items.note: How I Met Your Mother'da flört sahnelerinde.

items.example: He always weasels out of doing the dishes.
items.exampleTr: Bulaşık yıkamaktan hep kıvırıp kurtulur.
items.simple: Find a sneaky way to not do your job.
dialogue: A: Why is it my turn again?
B: Don't weasel out of it. It's your turn.
items.note: Malcolm in the Middle'da kardeş kavgalarında.

items.example: Come on, fess up. Who ate my leftovers?
items.exampleTr: Hadi itiraf et. Artıklarımı kim yedi?
items.simple: Say you did the bad thing. Be honest.
dialogue: A: Somebody broke the lamp.
B: Okay, fess up. Who did it?

items.example: After an hour of nagging, I caved in.
items.exampleTr: Bir saatlik dırdırdan sonra pes ettim.
items.simple: Give up and say yes after a long push.
dialogue: A: Did you buy him the toy?
B: Yes, I had to cave in.
items.note: Malcolm in the Middle'da ısrarcı çocuklar karşısında.

items.example: We really lucked out with the weather.
items.exampleTr: Havadan gerçekten şanslı çıktık.
items.simple: Good things happen to you by chance.
dialogue: A: How was the beach?
B: I think we'll luck out with sunny weather.

items.example: Can you dial back the drama a little?
items.exampleTr: Dramayı biraz kısabilir misin?
items.simple: Do less of something. Make it smaller.
dialogue: A: I'm just being friendly!
B: You need to dial back the hugging.

items.example: Instead of apologising, he doubled down.
items.exampleTr: Özür dilemek yerine daha da üstüne gitti.
items.simple: Say it again, even stronger, when people disagree.
dialogue: A: Did he admit he was wrong?
B: No, he'll double down on his story.
items.note: Modern Family ve The Office'te inatçı karakterlerde.

items.example: Ease off, man. She said she's sorry.
items.exampleTr: Biraz yavaş ol. Özür diledi ya.
items.simple: Be less strong or less pushy.
dialogue: A: I'll ask her ten more questions.
B: Ease off. She's had a long day.

items.example: He's always sucking up to the boss.
items.exampleTr: Hep patrona yaltaklanıyor.
items.simple: Be extra nice to someone to get something.
dialogue: A: Why did he bring her coffee?
B: He wants to suck up to her for a raise.

items.example: Don't let him rope someone into his crazy scheme.
items.exampleTr: Çılgın planına birini bulaştırmasına izin verme.
items.simple: Get someone to join, even if they don't want to.
dialogue: A: How did you end up at the school fair?
B: My sister will rope someone into helping, always.

items.example: Stop tiptoeing around it and tell me.
items.exampleTr: Lafı dolandırma, söyle bana.
items.simple: Be careful not to say the hard thing directly.
dialogue: A: Why is everyone so quiet?
B: We have to tiptoe around the divorce topic.

items.example: It's time you stood up to your brother.
items.exampleTr: Abinin karşısında durma zamanı geldi.
items.simple: Not be afraid of someone strong. Say no.
dialogue: A: He always takes my stuff.
B: You have to stand up to him.
items.note: Malcolm in the Middle'da anne ve abilere karşı.

items.example: His story raised a red flag for the team.
items.exampleTr: Hikayesi ekipte alarm zili çaldırdı.
items.simple: Something makes you think: be careful, maybe a problem.
dialogue: A: He paid in cash and wore sunglasses indoors.
B: That would raise a red flag for anyone.

items.example: She pulled strings to get us a table.
items.exampleTr: Masa bulmak için torpil kullandı.
items.simple: Use friends in high places to get what you want.
dialogue: A: How can we get tickets?
B: My uncle can pull strings for us.

items.example: Somebody has to take the fall for this.
items.exampleTr: Birinin bunun suçunu üstlenmesi lazım.
items.simple: Get the blame, even if it was not just you.
dialogue: A: The report was a disaster.
B: And Gary had to take the fall.

items.example: He bailed on us an hour before the party.
items.exampleTr: Partiden bir saat önce bizi ortada bıraktı.
items.simple: Say you will come, then not come.
dialogue: A: Where's Josh?
B: He'll bail on us again, I bet.
items.note: Friends ve HIMYM'de plan bozan arkadaşlarda.

items.example: Feel free to chime in if you disagree.
items.exampleTr: Katılmıyorsan çekinmeden söze gir.
items.simple: Add your words to a talk that others started.
dialogue: A: Does anyone have ideas?
B: Sure, let me chime in here.
items.note: The Office ve Modern Family'de aile sohbetlerinde.

items.example: She called him out for lying in front of everyone.
items.exampleTr: Herkesin önünde yalan söylediğini yüzüne vurdu.
items.simple: Say in public that someone did something wrong.
dialogue: A: Why is he so quiet now?
B: I had to call someone out, and it was him.

items.example: He tried to laugh off the embarrassing mistake.
items.exampleTr: Utanç verici hatayı gülüp geçmeye çalıştı.
items.simple: Pretend something bad is not a big deal.
dialogue: A: Weren't you upset by the joke?
B: No, I can laugh off things like that.

items.example: Can you walk me through what happened?
items.exampleTr: Ne olduğunu bana adım adım anlatır mısın?
items.simple: Explain slowly, one step at a time.
dialogue: A: I don't get the new software.
B: I can walk someone through it, like you.

items.example: Just own up to your mistake and move on.
items.exampleTr: Hatanı kabul et ve devam et.
items.simple: Say honestly that you did it.
dialogue: A: Will he say sorry?
B: He should own up to it.

items.example: Let's hash out the details over dinner.
items.exampleTr: Ayrıntıları yemekte uzun uzun konuşalım.
items.simple: Talk a long time until you agree.
dialogue: A: We can't agree on chores.
B: Let's hash out a deal tonight.
items.note: The Big Bang Theory'de oda arkadaşı anlaşmalarında.
